text: ちょうど　いいわ　おとうとを　きたえるのよ　てつだって！

structure.jp: おとうとを　きたえるのよ
structure.en: I'm training my little brother, you see

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives an explanation of the situation; のよ is the feminine way to say it. きたえるのよ = 'you see, I'm training him'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb on its own is a casual request. てつだって = 'help me'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way of stating something. ちょうど　いいわ = 'that's just right'.
